question: Which country does the composer of the song Nhu Mot Loi Chia Tay come from?

documents.title: Trinh Cong Son
documents.text: Trinh Cong Son (1939-2001) was a Vietnamese musician, songwriter, painter and poet, widely considered Vietnam's best songwriter.

documents.title: Nhu Mot Loi Chia Tay
documents.text: Nhu Mot Loi Chia Tay is a song written by Trinh Cong Son in the late 1980s and recorded by Khanh Ly.

documents.title: Khanh Ly
documents.text: Khanh Ly is a Vietnamese singer best known for performing the songs of Trinh Cong Son during the 1960s and 1970s.

documents.title: Hue
documents.text: Hue is a city in central Vietnam that served as the imperial capital of the Nguyen dynasty from 1802 to 1945.

documents.title: Bolero
documents.text: Bolero is a genre of slow-tempo Latin music and its associated dance, originating in Spain and Cuba.
